about_the_game:
This demo version contains a limited amount of content compared to the full game. It features fewer locations, weapons, perks, and magical abilities. Additionally, the number of enemy waves is reduced to 10.

A cooperative first-person action shooter for 1–4 players.

Fight waves of demons, undead, and monsters using weapons, magic, and perks. Each wave gets crazier, with more enemies and less time. Adapt your builds on the fly and change tactics to survive.

HELL IS COMING

Play solo or cooperatively with up to four players. Combine weapons and spells, share resources, and cover each other to hold back the darkness.

KEY FEATURES

  • • Endless waves of enemies — the further you go, the tougher it gets.
    • A diverse arsenal — from shotguns to magic.

    • Co-op for 1–4 players.
    • Unique builds and perks.
    • Random combinations of enemies, locations, and bonuses.

NOTHING WILL STOP THE WAVE
This is a fast, intense slaughter where there is no salvation — only you, hordes of monsters, and a sea of explosions. Hold the line and don’t spare the ammo.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu® 18.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual core processor or better
  • Graphics: Vulkan API compatible video card with 2024 MB or more of memory supporting Pixel Shader 4.0
  • Sound Card: With surround sound support 5.1 or 7.1
  • Additional Notes: Supports the option launch Vulkan Graphical API

name: DEMONOLITION Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual core processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible video card with 2024 MB or more of memory supporting Pixel Shader 4.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: With surround sound support 5.1 or 7.1
  • Additional Notes: Supports the option launch Vulkan Graphical API
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Quad core processor or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible video card with 4048 MB or more of memory supporting Pixel Shader 4.0
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: With surround sound support 5.1 or 7.1
  • Additional Notes: Supports the option launch Vulkan Graphical API

short_description: Hold back the waves of demons – solo or with friends. Level up, mix magic and perks, and choose the weapons that fit your style. With each round, the challenge intensifies. Only those who act quickly and in sync will survive.
supported_languages:

*languages with full audio support
